original_test_intent: Use the approved NVIDIA NVDebug tool to collect every required in-band and out-of-band diagnostic source without error and verify the defined 100% result.
original_method: An authorized operator installs the pinned tool, resolves its in-band/OOB collection manifest and access paths, captures full output and per-source status into protected storage, verifies artifact completeness/readability and creates redacted review copies.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the approved NVDebug build and source manifest; an authorized operator performs complete in-band and OOB collection into controlled storage and reviews every per-source error and artifact.
required_inputs: NVDebug package/version/hash, installation method and NVOnline document revision
Complete required in-band and OOB source manifest with expected filenames/types
Supported host and BMC/OOB endpoints, privileges and credential broker
Tool options, runtime, output directory and free-space estimate
Per-source success/error semantics and exact 100% denominator
Sensitive fields, retention, encryption, access and redaction policy
Artifact size/readability/hash validation and secure transfer method
OOB session cleanup and independent BMC/platform recovery
safety_requirements: Never embed passwords or disable SSH host-key verification
Do not publish raw logs that may contain credentials, tokens, serials, topology or customer data
Preserve complete raw output; redact copies rather than modifying originals
Do not infer success from a filename, directory listing or truncated stdout
Prevent output overwrite and monitor storage exhaustion
Stop on BMC/OOB access loss, privilege error, unexpected state change, sensitive-data spill or platform anomaly; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify package, document and collection-manifest identities
Preflight authenticated endpoints, privileges, storage and protected output location
Invoke only an approved non-destructive collection workflow and capture full status when authorized
Validate artifact manifest, sizes, hashes and per-source outcomes; prepare redacted derivatives
Perform no package install, credential disclosure, unapproved OOB access, raw-log publication, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Provide package, full source manifest, secure access and pass denominator
Approve install/collection scope and sensitive-data policy
Resolve any missing or errored source without hiding it
Review complete protected evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Invoking nvdebug is directionally relevant, but insecure SSH, output truncation and a grep of /var/log cannot establish complete error-free in-band/OOB collection.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the pinned documented NVDebug collection command with secure host verification, full output capture and an explicit OOB endpoint/manifest; validate every produced artifact.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both in-band and OOB collection, NVOnline 1109504, 100% criterion and 30/60-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: PACKAGE-GATED DUAL-PLANE DIAGNOSTIC COLLECTION WITH DATA-GOVERNANCE CONTROLS
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate a run manifest that maps each required source to endpoint, collector step, result code and artifact hash; store raw data encrypted and emit separately redacted review artifacts.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete source accounting, secure access, artifact validation, data governance and cleanup instead of relying on truncated console samples.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A help command or file listing proves neither collection nor content integrity; both in-band and OOB manifest entries must have independently verifiable results.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: In-band and OOB collectors may access different clocks, identities and retention windows. Files can exist yet be empty, stale or copied from another run, so timestamps, source identity, size and hashes must be tied to one collection manifest.

project_override_considerations: If policy forbids exporting a sensitive source, engineering may retain and attest it within an approved enclave, but must preserve its manifest entry and verification result; omission cannot silently count as pass.
expected_evidence: NVDebug package/document hashes, installation audit and resolved collection manifest
Authenticated in-band/OOB endpoint identities and credential-safe execution audit
Complete stdout/stderr, exit status and per-source artifact metadata/hashes
Independent total/pass/fail/skip/error calculation for the 100% criterion
Raw-data protection/redaction record, OOB cleanup, post-reachability and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require error-free in-band/OOB collection and a 100% result. Missing package, manifest and denominator details are readiness gaps rather than competing statements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is package- and access-gated, not intrinsically blocked. Static review is complete and execution can proceed when the approved tool, manifest and data policy are supplied.

review_improvement: Replaces insecure truncated sampling with complete dual-plane source accounting, cryptographic artifact identity and controlled raw/redacted evidence handling.
independent_technical_reasoning: Diagnostic collection success is a per-source property: the top-level tool can exit successfully while an OOB plugin times out or produces a stale file. Conversely, a directory entry proves nothing about readability or run identity. A manifest that binds each source result to endpoint, timestamp, size and hash is necessary to support a genuine 100% claim and to prevent sensitive raw data from being mistaken for a safe review artifact.
